lines: In the Aldok province, Linagarten seems to be struggling to recover after a terrible cold front hit some of its largest farms.
Previously under the tyrannical rule of the nobility, Aldok has had an easier transition to self-sufficiency due to housing the largest farms in Aijinkova.
Linagarten, especially, is home to the largest grain fields in the country.

Aijinkova has enough grain to push past this difficult time, but this may create some foreign conflict after Aijinkova's trade agreement with three neighboring countries to supply food in exchange for arms.
This may mean the country would need to import grain to meet those agreements, putting financial stress on the People's Government.
